STRONG LEAD, NOT YET UNLOCKED: the storefront GraphQL endpoint https://www.pizzahut.co.uk/ph_uk/storefront/graphql accepts unauthenticated introspection and DOES define per-item protein - type NutritionalValuePerBasis{basis energyCalories energyKilojoules protein fatTotal fatSaturated cholesterol carbohydrateTotal carbohydrateSugar sodium}, with NutritionalValueBasis enum PER_SERVING|PER_100_GRAMS|PER_100_MILLILITERS, reached via Nutrition.nutritionalValues. The menu path is storeByNumber(storeNumber).menuByChannel or menuById(menuId:UUID). Blocked because Store/menu types return UNAUTHORIZED ('Access denied to one or more GraphQL types') without a store context or auth header, and no API key was found in main.69a8ef1feb9adb3d.js.
